prompt: Design a luxury residential showcase website for The Lumina Terraces based on evals/fixtures/visual-quality/real-estate-brief.json. Provide 4 page roles (Home Vision, Residences & Floor Plans, Amenities & Neighborhood, Private Preview Booking). Prioritize sculptural elegance, high-fidelity architectural visualization, interactive floorplate selection, and discreet private inquiry.
expected_outcomes: Understated luxury expressed through high-fashion display serif typography and warm travertine/bronze tones
Technical architectural page features legible floorplans with clear dimension callouts and material swatches
Neighborhood curation features editorial lifestyle photography with cultural district highlights
Floorplan previewers and reservation dialogs scale gracefully to mobile viewports
Deterministic visual gates pass with clean DOM and valid meta tags
must_not: Use tacky commercial real-estate urgency banners ('Only 2 units left!')
Use low-resolution floorplan images that become illegible when scaled
Feature watermarked stock realtor headshots or commercial office photography
Duplicate section structures between Home and Residences
